name: Cascading Style Sheets
standard: W3C CSS Working Group Standards & Snapshots

categories.name: CSS Tarixi va Modul Standartlari

categories.name: Sintaksis, Kaskad va Spetsifiklik (Specificity)

categories.name: CSS Box Model va O‘lchamlar
categories.description: Content, Padding, Border, Margin, box-sizing: border-box, margin collapsing.

categories.name: Ranglar, Gradientlar va Fonlar

categories.name: Tipografiya va Shriftlar

categories.name: 1D Moslashuvchan Layout (Flexbox)
